# game/buffer_6400.asm: Fill of the RAM at $6400

### [`fill_buffer_6400`](../../../../src/game/buffer_6400.asm#L6) `$5220`

*routine*

Fills $6400-$653f with $0b. Writes 1, 2, 3 and $ae at $6584, $65d4, $6624, and zeros at $6487, $64d7, $6627. No code reads this RAM.
